ideas.title: string - short name of the idea, at most 12 words
ideas.statement: string - the idea as a testable proposition
ideas.operator: method-transfer | analogy | combination | inversion | assumption-relaxation | generalization | specialization | scale-shift | contradiction-resolution | gap-filling
parents: string - slugs of the parent notes actually used
ideas.rationale: string - why the combination should work (mechanism)
ideas.novelty_check: string - what is new vs the parents and existing ideas; what search would show it is not new
ideas.test: string - smallest decisive experiment, proof or dataset that could refute it
ideas.next_step: string - one concrete action of at most one day
